_Transaction: minimal transaction with description, hash (sha256 of the description) and repr_json, with only what Block uses from the transactions.

run(fields): receives a dictionary with index, timestamp, transactions (descriptions), previous_hash and, optionally, proof; builds the helper transactions and the block (without proof when it is not given, so the default applies) and returns block.repr_json().
Checked: Pysmell only flags the __init__ of the snippet (PAR=7); nothing in the scaffolding.
pinned_behavior: typical: block 1 with two transactions, previous_hash and proof 42; repr_json with the sha256 hash of index, timestamp, transaction hashes, previous_hash and proof.
edge: initial block (index 0, no transactions, previous_hash None) without proof; proof stays None, the default.
invalid: the snippet validates nothing; data of the wrong type (index as text, negative timestamp, previous_hash as an integer) is accepted and shows up as given.
not_pinned_on_purpose: Accepting extra arguments (*args, **kwargs): the only caller is run, which the refactoring may adjust; removing *args and **kwargs does not fail.
Attribute names: the tests observe through repr_json and hash.
notes: PAR=7 counts *args and **kwargs (each is a piece without '=' in the signature). Without them, there are 5 parameters without a default (self, index, timestamp, transactions, previous_hash), still at the threshold.
